<header id="header">
<div>
<h1 class="header-title">MAT290: Advanced<br>Engineering Mathematics</h1>
<div class="header-subtitle">University of Toronto &middot; St. George</div>
<div class="header-term">Fall 2026 &middot; LEC0101</div>
</div>
<div id="header-image"><img src="images/complex-plane.svg" alt="A point on the complex unit circle" width="190" height="156"></div>
</header>

<p class="course-intro">This course develops the tools of ordinary differential equations, Laplace transforms and complex analysis. We study the behaviour of solutions, complex differentiability, contour integrals, series and residues.</p>
